cmd.chains.help: Liiska miiska silsiladaha rolar: lambarada silsiladda oo leh pitch, dhexroorka rolar-ka, ballaca gudaha iyo joogta saxanka, iyo inta liisas ku heshiiya.
cmd.chainsources.help: Tus liisaska dadweynaha ee laga akhriyay cabbirrada silsiladda.
cmd.sprocket.help: Ka sawir xiddigta silsiladda lambar silsilad iyo tirada ilkaha: foomka ilkaha, wareegga pitch-ka, khadadka dhexe iyo godka.
chains.head: Silsiladaha rolar: {n} safka. Millimitir. p = pitch, d1 = dhexroorka rolar-ka (bushing-ka 25 iyo 35), b1 = ballaca u dhexeeya saxanada gudaha, h2 = joogta saxanka gudaha.
chains.agree: ugu yaraan {n} liis ayaa ku heshiiya p, d1, b1
chains.foot: Laga akhriyay liisaska dadweynaha, meelaha laba liis ku heshiiyaan; lama koobiyeeyn ISO 606 ama ASME B29.1. CHAINSOURCES ayaa liisaska soo bandhigaysa.
src.head: Liisaska loo akhriyay miiska silsiladda (la soo qaaday {date}):
src.not_standard: Kuwani waa bogagga soo saarayaasha iyo tixraaca. Ma haysanno ISO 606 ama ANSI/ASME B29.1, wax halkan ah lama koobiyeeyn ka soo jeedo.
ask.chain: Lambarka silsiladda, tusaale ahaan 40, 80, 08A ama 10B (ugu dambeeyay: {last})
err.chain: Silsilad {name} ma jirto miiska. Ku qor CHAINS si aad u aragto lambarada silsiladaha ku jira.
err.teeth: Xiddigtu waxay u baahan tahay tiro buuxa oo ilkaha ah, ugu yaraan 6.
err.bore: Godku waa inuu ka badnaadaa 0 oo ka baxsanaadaa wareegga xididka.
done: Xiddigta silsilad {chain}, {n} ilkood: dhexroorka pitch {D}, dhexroorka xididka {Df}, dhexroorka ilka {Dt} mm.
mesh.ok: Waa la hubiyay silsiladda loo sameeyay: rolar-ka way fadhiyaan oo qaabka ka fogaadaan ugu yaraan {gap} mm.
mesh.bad: Hubin ma guuleysan: silsiladdu si fiican uma fadhiisan tirada ilkaha. Isku day ilko badan.
note.tooth: Qaabka ilka waa kan add-on-kan u gaar ah (dulqaadka fadhiga {c} %, xagga fadhiga badhka {beta} darajo, ilka {tip} p ka sare wareegga pitch-ka), ma aha qaabka ilka ee heerka. Ka hubi bixiyaha xiddigtaada ka hor intaadan gooyn.
note.noplate: Joogta saxanka silsiladdan laba liis ma ku heshiiyaan, sidaas darteed waa laga reebay; looma isticmaalin qaabka.
